Class PhoneConnection

java.lang.Object
br.edu.unipampa.varzinho.infrastructure.stream.PhoneConnection
public final class PhoneConnection extends Object
A phone whose stream FFmpeg is already recording, with the camera that captures from it. This is the one place that knows the phone is reached through FFmpeg; the window only sees a camera and a feed.

  • Method Details

    • open

      public static Optional<PhoneConnection> open(String streamUrl, Path segmentFolder, int bufferSeconds, Consumer<String> onFailure)
      Starts recording the phone at streamUrl into segmentFolder.
      Parameters:
      streamUrl - the phone's stream address; blank or missing when there is no phone
      segmentFolder - the folder the recorder's ring of segments is written to
      bufferSeconds - how many seconds the phone's camera keeps, and so how long its clips are
      onFailure - told why, in words for the operator, when an address was given but the phone could not be reached
      Returns:
      the connected phone; empty when no address was given, or when it failed

    • start

      public static PhoneConnection start(String streamUrl, Path segmentFolder, int bufferSeconds) throws IOException
      Starts recording the phone, failing loudly instead of falling back to no phone.
      Parameters:
      streamUrl - the phone's stream address
      segmentFolder - the folder the recorder's ring of segments is written to
      bufferSeconds - how many seconds the phone's camera keeps
      Returns:
      the phone, recording; its footage may not have arrived yet
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the address, the folder or the buffer length is invalid
      IOException - if FFmpeg is missing, the folder cannot be cleared, or no loopback port is free

      public String liveRelay()

    • awaitFootage

      public void awaitFootage()
      Waits up to fifteen seconds for the first finished segment. Only a completed segment proves that FFmpeg could read the supplied address. On failure the recorder is stopped.
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if no segment arrives in time or FFmpeg exits first
      UncheckedIOException - if the phone refused the connection; its cause names only the host and port, never the full address

    • disconnect

      public void disconnect()
      Stops recording the phone. Safe to call more than once.

    • feed

      public Feed feed(Runnable onSilence)
      Builds the feed that moves the phone's new segments into its camera. Call it once: every feed reads the same segment list on its own, so a second one would hand the camera each segment twice.
      Parameters:
      onSilence - run when the phone's segments stop arriving
      Returns:
      the feed that moves the phone's new segments into its camera

    • onDrop

      public void onDrop(Runnable action)
      Reports the phone dropping out, which ends the recording without anyone asking.
      Parameters:
      action - run, on FFmpeg's own thread, once the recorder exits for any reason other than being stopped
